text:
emily: Heads-up — planning a time-locked primer push across X + LinkedIn for the webinar on Tue 11am PT. Need assets, short-copy variants, and a seedlist. Who can own scheduling?
raj: I can own scheduling in Buffer. What windows are we thinking for the primer vs main thread?
maria: Primer = Tue 8:30am PT (soft nudge), Main thread = 10:50am PT (5–10 min pre-webinar), Follow-ups = Wed morning.
sam: I can write 3 X variations: teaser, benefit-first, and benchmark-led. Need the one-pager with metrics to reference.
emily: Attached the slide export here: https://drive.redwood/workspace/launch-briefs/primer-onepager_v2.pdf — call out the 30% latency improvement and 2x throughput number. Legal sign-off needed on the exact phrasing.
olivia: Can you drop the exact headline lines you want? I’ll QA for compliance quickly.
emily: Heads-up copy snippets: 
- Teaser: "See how teams cut inference cost by 35% while keeping p99 latency low. Live demo Tue 11am PT. Register -> short.link/wbnr"
- Benefit-first: "Ship LLM features that scale — lower cost, predictable latency. Join our live playbook Tue 11am PT."
- Benchmark-led: "Independent benchmark: 2x throughput at comparable latency. Demo + deep-dive Tue 11am PT."
raj: For tracking use UTM: utm_source=x_tweet&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=webinar_mar2026&utm_content=primer1. I’ll append.
sam: Quick ask — can someone confirm a preferred image/crop for X vs LinkedIn? Square for LI, landscape for X?
maria: I exported 1200x628 banner + 1080x1080 square. Link: https://drive.redwood/creative/webinar-banners.zip
emily: SDR routing: @sdr-bot can we route inbound registrants from these social posts to the webinar nurture queue with tag = "social-primer-mar2026"?
sdr-bot: Confirmed. Registrants with utm_campaign=webinar_mar2026 will be assigned to queue:webinar-nurture and owner rotation: regional-SDRs.
olivia: Paid boost — do we have budget for a small X paid push for the benchmark post? Asking growth.
emily: We have up to $1.2k for paid amplification. Prioritize benchmark-led post and the second-day follow-up.
raj: Scheduling checklist for me: copy variants, final image per channel, CTA link (short.link/wbnr), UTM string, publish times (8:30am PT, 10:50am PT, Wed 9am PT), approval flag. I’ll schedule drafts by Mon 5pm PT.
sam: I’ll upload copy as comments in the Buffer draft + include alt-text for images.
maria: One more — can we pin a short thread on LinkedIn with TL;DR + slide carousel? I’ll make a 6-slide carousel from the deck.
emily: Yes — please coordinate carousel with the main-thread post. Also prepare a 1-paragraph follow-up to seed to prospects next week.
raj: Got it. I'll tag the draft with "needs: legal" once copy is in. Olivia please approve legal phrasing; emily please confirm metrics phrasing before that.
olivia: Will do. If anything looks risky I’ll flag it in the draft.
emily: Thanks team — next sync Thu 11am PT for any last-minute tweaks. :thumbsup:
